mapper.select: SELECT * FROM t_inventory_out ORDER BY out_date DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO t_inventory_out (out_no, out_type, material_id, material_name, quantity, unit_price, total_amount, warehouse_id, out_date, create_by, create_time, remark) VALUES (#{outNo}, #{outType}, #{materialId}, #{materialName}, #{quantity}, #{unitPrice}, #{totalAmount}, #{warehouseId}, #{outDate}, #{createBy}, #{createTime}, #{remark})
mapper.update: UPDATE t_inventory_out SET out_no = #{outNo}, out_type = #{outType}, material_id = #{materialId}, material_name = #{materialName}, quantity = #{quantity}, unit_price = #{unitPrice}, total_amount = #{totalAmount}, warehouse_id = #{warehouseId}, out_date = #{outDate}, remark = #{remark} WHERE id = #{id}
